Markets.title: ICICI Prudential AMC gets RBI approval to buy up to 9.95% stake in Kotak and 3 other banks
Markets.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has approved ICICI Prudential AMC to acquire up to a 9.95% stake in Kotak Mahindra Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, CSB Bank, and DCB Bank. The asset management company will make these acquisitions on behalf of its various mutual fund schemes.

Markets.title: US stocks calm ahead of midterm polls, but markets may be underpricing the risk
Markets.summary: US stocks are trading near record highs ahead of the midterm elections with unusually low market volatility. Analysts warn that this low volatility and limited demand for downside protection may leave investors vulnerable to unexpected market shocks.

Markets.title: RBL Bank raises $350 million in debut international bond sale
Markets.summary: RBL Bank raised $350 million in its first international bond sale by pricing the bonds tighter than initial guidance. Strong investor demand will support the bank's liability management and growth at GIFT City, bolstered by backing from Emirates NBD.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets extended their losing streak for a third consecutive day due to soaring oil prices and Middle East tensions. The Sensex fell 813 points, the Nifty dropped 204 points, and BSE market capitalization lost over Rs 2 lakh crore amid broad-based selling.

Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks slide as oil tops $100, stoking fresh inflation fears
Markets.summary: US stocks dropped as Brent crude surpassed $100 a barrel due to escalating US-Iran tensions and disrupted shipments in the Strait of Hormuz. The surge in fuel costs revived inflation fears and complicated the Federal Reserve's upcoming interest-rate decision.

Markets.title: Rupee falls to 95.11 vs US dollar as West Asia tensions drive oil fears
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee dropped 0.3% to 95.1050 against the U.S. dollar as rising military tensions in West Asia pushed Brent crude prices above $100. Although Reserve Bank of India intervention limited the losses, traders expect continued currency volatility due to geopolitical risks and fluctuating oil prices.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
Geo-Political.summary: German conservative leader Friedrich Merz clashed with AfD leader Alice Weidel during a stormy parliamentary debate following the far-right party's regional election victory. Merz accused the AfD of pursuing a migration policy that amounts to "ethnic cleansing" of skilled workers.

Geo-Political.title: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
Geo-Political.summary: Google is investing 13 billion euros to build its largest European data centre in Finland. The project is expected to create tens of thousands of jobs.

Geo-Political.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Global benchmark Brent crude reached $100 a barrel for the first time since July following US strikes on five Iranian tankers. The price increase occurred amid escalating tensions involving the US and Houthi forces.

Geo-Political.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
Geo-Political.summary: The United States is banning imports of specific Canadian alcohol, dairy products, and motorbikes. This action is the newest development in an ongoing trade war, following Canada's implementation of counter-tariffs on American goods.

Geo-Political.title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
Geo-Political.summary: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings attended proceedings in Norway on Wednesday. They were among European royalty who gathered to pay their respects to King Harald V.

Geo-Political.title: N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog
Geo-Political.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency reports that North Korea has constructed a new two-storey uranium enrichment facility. The nuclear watchdog has stated that this development is a cause for serious concern.

AI & Tech.summary: A digital creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected visibility occurred without paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization techniques.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal bats for common Brics trade platform, women-focused fund
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal advocated for a common BRICS trade platform at a recent conference. He also proposed the creation of a women-focused fund ahead of the alliance's summit.

Data & Insights.title: India-Thailand trade talks focus on market access, Asean trade agreement review
Data & Insights.summary: India and Thailand have agreed to a time-bound review of their Asean trade agreement to address India's expanding trade deficit, which reached $10.81 billion in 2025. Both countries also plan to strengthen business-to-business linkages to promote balanced economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Brent crosses $100 as West Asia war raises pressure on India’s economy
Data & Insights.summary: Brent crude has crossed $100 per barrel due to the escalating conflict in West Asia. This price surge threatens to increase India's oil import bill, leading to higher inflation and fiscal challenges.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet clears  ₹10,783 crore rail expansion as key corridors near capacity
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian cabinet has approved ₹10,783 crore to fund three railway multi-tracking projects spanning 655 kilometers to ease network congestion. These infrastructure upgrades will increase annual freight capacity by 26.69 million tonnes while reducing carbon emissions and creating jobs.

Data & Insights.title: BJP’s war chest grew  ₹905 crore during 2026 polls, Congress’ shrank  ₹66 crore: What EC data reveals
Data & Insights.summary: During the 2026 assembly elections, the BJP's financial war chest grew by ₹905 crore while the Congress's shrank by ₹66 crore. Election Commission data shows that during the March 15 to May 6 period, Congress reported net receipts of ₹207.17 crore against an expenditure of ₹248.55 crore across five regions.

India.summary: The woman's husband, Ramanuj Goswami, was also taken to the house.

India.title: Assam Official Arrested Over Scam, Used Mimics To Impersonate Chief Minister
India.summary: Assam official Debeswar Sharma was arrested by the Chief Minister's Special Vigilance Cell in a multi-crore cheating and corruption case. He allegedly used voice mimics to impersonate the Chief Minister during the scam.

India.title: Arvind Kejriwal Unanimously Re-Elected As AAP National Convener
India.summary: Arvind Kejriwal has been unanimously re-elected as the national convener of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP). During the meeting, Kejriwal and other senior leaders also briefed members on the party's future strategy.

India.title: 'National Award Not Any State's Property': Gujarat BJP Slams Uddhav Thackeray
India.summary: Gujarat BJP chief spokesperson Dr Anil Patel criticized Uddhav Thackeray by stating that National Awards belong to all of India rather than any single state. He emphasized that films from various languages across the country compete for these honors.

India.title: Apple iPhone Launch Event Live Updates: Apple Launches First Foldable iPhone, Gives Hat-Tip To iPad
India.summary: Apple launched its first foldable iPhone during a major event hosted by new CEO John Ternus, who succeeded Tim Cook. The presentation also included a nod to the company's iPad lineup.

India.title: Tamil Nadu's Ruling Alliance Gets A Name, Flags Secularism, Social Justice
India.summary: Tamil Nadu's ruling alliance has adopted a new name that emphasizes secularism and social justice. VCK leader SS Balaji stated that Chief Minister Vijay conceived the idea for the name.

General.title: Police launch criminal investigation into Reform UK donations
General.summary: Police have launched a criminal investigation into donations made to Reform UK. This inquiry is now part of an ongoing investigation into other donations, following a Channel 4 News broadcast.

General.title: Air traffic failure was avoidable, says transport secretary
General.summary: Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander stated that a technical glitch causing over 2,000 flight cancellations was avoidable. She has ordered a formal investigation into the air traffic failure.

General.title: National security can't come at expense of social security, Burnham says
General.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that national security funding must not compromise social security support. He pledged to simultaneously increase defense spending and reduce the welfare bill through Labour policies.

General.title: Watch: Europe's royalty pay last respects to King Harald V in Norway
General.summary: Tens of thousands of people lined the streets of Norway after 13 days of national mourning to pay their respects to King Harald V. European royalty also attended the funeral to pay their final respects.

General.title: Miliband rejects chief rabbi's claim British Jews in greater danger after sanctions move
General.summary: Foreign Secretary Miliband has rejected the chief rabbi's claim that imposing sanctions on Israeli settlements increases the risk to British Jews. Miliband stated that he disagrees with the assessment regarding the safety of the Jewish community in the UK.

General.title: RNLI volunteer targeted online and branded 'traitor' after Portsmouth protests
General.summary: An RNLI volunteer from Portsmouth was falsely identified online and branded a traitor for supposedly helping small boat migrants. The lifeboat crew member spoke with BBC Verify to address the false accusations.
